_method: Claude (Fable 5, Sonnet-5-class) read all 300 sample resumes in 6 batches of 50 via the harness Read tool (resumes.jsonl only; meta.jsonl and sample-gold.json were NOT read). For each JD it extracted (area, skills list, years) from the resume text and ranked: (1) resumes matching area + >=2 required skills + min years, ordered by required-skill count then years desc; (2) 1-required-skill area matches; (3) same-area seniority backfill to 20. Wall time 13:18:57 -> 13:21:25 = 148.7s.
